svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cross members: cut two 500 mm lengths of 25 x 25 x 2 RHS.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: They are welded under the rails, flush with the rails' outer faces:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rear one 0 to 30 mm from the rails' rear ends, middle one 560 to 590.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 9 mm holes in the top face of the rear one for M6 rivet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nuts, 80 mm each side of centre, 14 mm from its front face (heel guard).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nose beam: cut 500 mm of 60 x 40 x 2 RHS, lying flat (40 mm tall).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Its rear face butts the front ends of both rails, bottoms flush,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outer ends flush with the rails' outer faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The down tube stands on the middle of its top face (sheet 103).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 9 mm holes in the top for M6 rivet nuts, 12 mm from the rear

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face, 80 and 180 mm each side of centre (toe guard flanges).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cap every open RHS end with 2 mm plate, welded all round.
